incidents.name: GSS pair-balance skim
incidents.notes: GSS's transfer path takes tokens out of the liquidity pair's own balance without a sync(), so the attacker skim()ed the resulting surplus and swapped it for the pair's USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: GSS 0x37e42B961AE37883BAc2fC29207A5F88eFa5db66 created 2023-08-23T06:22:32Z by 0x008ca6c5f41e846d2570033af0f87d483ccc77e1, unrelated to attack sender 0x84f37f6cc75ccde5fe9ba99093824a11cfdc329d; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 25,964.72 USDT left the GSS/USDT pool 0x1ad2cB3C2606E6D5e45c339d10f81600bdbf75C0 and 24,883.44 USDT reached the attack contract.
